name: update_entry_group
description:
Updates an Entry Group or Context Set (`display_name`, `description`, or `labels`) in Knowledge Catalog.

This is a long-running operation. To complete this task:
1. Capture the `operation_id` (the last segment of the `name` field) from the response of this tool.
2. Poll the `get_operation` tool using `project_id`, `location`, and this `operation_id` until `done` is true.

description.description: Optional. Updated plain-text summary description of the Entry Group or Context Set.

displayName.description: Optional. Updated user-friendly display name of the Entry Group or Context Set.

entryGroupId.description: Required. The ID of the Entry Group or Context Set to update (for example, `finance-context-set`).

labels.description: Optional. Updated user-defined labels for the Entry Group or Context Set.

location.description: Required. The Google Cloud location of the Entry Group or Context Set (for example, `us-central1` or `global`).

projectId.description: Required. The Google Cloud project ID containing the Entry Group or Context Set.

updateMask.description: Required. Mask of fields to update (`display_name`, `description`, `labels`).
